doc: Blind rerun (I96): the typed-sorts sidecar of M3 (holon.sorts.typed_sidecar). Its one transitions document is the Rollup document the pinned checkout's extraction writes (spec/M2/lib/extract_rollup.json), its seeds file spec/M3/lib/sort_seeds.json, its binding the binding spec spec/M3/lib/binding.json (the deployment whose storage is Reach's initial state). No search section: the searches keep the tooling's defaults.
